aboutPage.heroSubtitle: We are a team of visual branding specialists, dedicated to helping businesses in Gandhinagar and beyond make a lasting impression.
aboutPage.storyHeadline: We believe that visibility is everything.
aboutPage.storyParagraph1: At Jalaram Digital Sign, we don't just print banners or manufacture signs. We build the visual components that allow your brand to be seen, recognized, and trusted in the real world.
aboutPage.storyParagraph2: Founded on the principles of precision and quality, our facility in Sector 11, Gandhinagar is equipped to handle everything from intricate acrylic 3D letters to massive outdoor flex installations.
aboutPage.storyParagraph3: We understand that when you invest in physical branding, you are investing in your business's reputation. That's why we approach every project—no matter the size—with the same level of craftsmanship and attention to detail.
aboutPage.qualitySubtitle: We combine modern printing technology with hands-on fabrication expertise to deliver outstanding results.

bannerSizes.notes: Provide design in actual print size. Include 0.5 inch bleed. Font should be outlined/embedded.
For cut vinyl (single color), provide vector file. For printed vinyl, send high-res artwork.

bannerSizes.material: 500 GSM Star Flex / Front Lit Flex
bannerSizes.dpi: 15-25 DPI @ full scale (300 DPI thumbnail scale-up)
bannerSizes.notes: For large hoardings, artwork can be at 1:10 scale at 150 DPI. Confirm exact size before sending file.
For transparent or backlit effects, provide separate white layer. Mention substrate material when ordering.
Design must be bold with high contrast — lighter images do not print well on perforated film.
Provide logo and text in vector format. Mention if backlit or front-lit is required.

portfolio.title: Highway & Urban Hoardings
portfolio.description: Massive roadside billboards and high-impact structural hoardings designed for maximum brand exposure across Gandhinagar and major highway corridors.

portfolio.title: High-Resolution Flex Banners
portfolio.description: Vibrant, weather-resistant flex and star flex banners with reinforced grommets for storefront promotions, grand openings, and large-scale public events.

portfolio.title: Commercial Vinyl Printing
portfolio.description: Precision-cut, high-grade self-adhesive vinyl for storefront branding, corporate wall murals, floor graphics, and commercial vehicle fleet wraps.

portfolio.title: Radium & Reflective Work
portfolio.description: High-intensity radium and micro-prismatic retro-reflective sheet cutting for glow-in-the-dark night visibility, safety boards, and traffic signage.

portfolio.title: Flatbed UV Printing
portfolio.description: Direct-to-substrate UV printing on acrylic, wood, glass, ACP, and sunboard delivering ultra-sharp resolution, vivid color depth, and scratch-resistant durability.

portfolio.title: 1-Way Vision Glass Graphics
portfolio.description: Perforated window film graphics offering full-color exterior branding and privacy while maintaining crystal-clear outward visibility from indoors.

portfolio.title: 3D Laser-Cut Acrylic Boards
portfolio.description: Custom laser-cut acrylic letters, embossed 3D logo plaques, clear reception backdrops, and premium polished corporate identity boards.

portfolio.title: Illuminated Glow Sign Boards
portfolio.description: Backlit aluminum-cased glow sign boxes with high-lumen internal LED lighting and weather-proof flex faces for 24/7 retail and corporate recognition.

portfolio.title: LED Display & Channel Boards
portfolio.description: Energy-efficient programmable scrolling LED message boards and vibrant 3D front-lit / back-lit LED channel lettering for striking night presence.

faqs.question: What types of banners do you print?
faqs.answer: We print a wide variety of banners including standard flex banners, star flex, backlit banners, and fabric banners suitable for both indoor and outdoor use.

faqs.question: Can you print custom sizes?
faqs.answer: Yes, our large-format printing capabilities allow us to print banners and signage in virtually any custom size to fit your specific requirements.

faqs.question: Do you provide installation services?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer professional installation services for signage, large banners, and vehicle branding across Gandhinagar and surrounding areas.

faqs.question: How quickly can an order be completed?
faqs.answer: Standard orders are typically completed within 24-48 hours. Complex signage or large bulk orders may require more time, which we will discuss during the quotation phase.
